title: MAYA Remote Protocol Framed Message
description: A single framed message per protocol-spec.json: a 15-byte big-endian binary header (protocolVersion, messageType, messageId, payloadLength) followed by a variable-length JSON payload. Payload is represented as a base64-encoded string; its decoded byte length must equal payloadLength.

protocolVersion.description: uint8 protocol version. Must equal the version in protocol-spec.json (1).

messageType.description: uint16 message type. Values taken from protocol-spec.json messageTypes (PING=1, PONG=2, PAIR_REQUEST=10, ...).

messageId.description: uint64 monotonically increasing message identifier used for request/response correlation.

payloadLength.description: uint32 payload length in bytes. Upper bound is maxPayloadBytes (1048576 / 1 MiB) from protocol-spec.json framing.

payload.description: Base64-encoded payload bytes. Decoded length must equal payloadLength. The decoded payload is a JSON object whose schema depends on messageType.
